evidenceKind: Complete-routine source review; not a new compiled execution probe
conclusions: Start16 resolves the hit before allocating combat. Successful hits roll skill poison before ordinary weapon allocation. Allocation fills weapon damage,calculates total damage and stores a copy before the action event.

The generic start wrapper consumes mana after a successful start unless UseManaOnDo or its explicit bypass applies. The pinned row has a real start callback and no UseManaOnDo flag. AttackNoMana is explicitly set.

Do32 sets the server-do flag,fetches the target again and drains the stored combat record. DrainItemDurability checks current reach,delivers successful stored damage and updates player weapon durability; melee-attempt events also occur on stored misses/blocks.

The complete total calculator includes mitigated poison rate once in immediate damage,even for player attackers. ExecuteEvents subtracts the stored total independently of later poison state ticks. Modern applicability remains unobserved.
The existing shared GetResultFlags implementation and its16384compiled controls supply decision order. The player adapter supplies additive skill AR and the existing recipient shield rule.
limits: This review hashes complete pinned source routines and checks specific source-order anchors. It does not execute the start/do wrappers or prove all their branches via a new compiler probe.
Native weapon geometry,hostility,component-choice RNG,presentation and current executable behavior remain adapters. The broader player damage/event/return pipeline is not certified by this review.

The full reviewed DrainItemDurability route includes attempt events,Thorns and later missile/free ordering. Their complete native player composition remains separate work; do not mark the class complete.
